mapper.select: SELECT id, total_budget, per_symbol_budget, dry_run, circuit_breaker_tripped, circuit_breaker_tripped_at, updated_at FROM auto_trade_state WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE auto_trade_state SET circuit_breaker_tripped = 1, circuit_breaker_tripped_at = #{at}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = 1
UPDATE auto_trade_state SET dry_run = #{dryRun}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = 1
